cues.en: Mike: This is going to be a really fun and exciting video.
cues.zh: 這會是一部非常有趣、令人興奮的影片。

cues.en: We are going to get to solve math problems and see how two seemingly unrelated expressions in mathematics are actually really closely related
cues.zh: 我們要解數學問題，看看兩個看似無關的數學算式，其實如何密切，

cues.en: to each other.
cues.zh: 相互關聯。

cues.en: So I hope you're excited.
cues.zh: 希望你很期待。

cues.en: The first thing that I'm going to introduce you to is a function called the sigmoid.
cues.zh: 首先要介紹的，是叫做 Sigmoid 的函數。

cues.en: This is a function for a sigmoid.
cues.zh: 這就是 Sigmoid 函數。

cues.en: We have one divided by one plus E to the minus beta times X.
cues.zh: 1 除以 1 加 e 的 −βx 次方。

cues.en: So X is our function variable.
cues.zh: x 是函數的變數。

cues.en: You can just think of it as, you know, you can think of it as time or space.
cues.zh: 可以把它想成時間或空間。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter, it's just some, you know, sort of continuous number.
cues.zh: 那並不重要，它只是某種連續的數。

cues.en: And beta is a parameter here.
cues.zh: β 則是這裡的一個參數。

cues.en: So we can look at this in algebra, but this is also pretty easy to graph because it's a function of one variable.
cues.zh: 可以從代數角度看它，但因為只含一個變數，也很容易畫圖。

cues.en: So the sigmoid function looks like this.
cues.zh: Sigmoid 函數看起來像這樣。

cues.en: We see here is X on the X axis. So that's this value here.
cues.zh: 這裡 x 軸是 x，也就是這個值。

cues.en: And then this is the function value on the Y axis.
cues.zh: y 軸則是函數值。

cues.en: So they call it a sigma because it looks a little bit like an S.
cues.zh: 之所以叫 Sigmoid，是因為它看起來有點像 S。

cues.en: In some literatures, it's also called an S curve.
cues.zh: 有些文獻也叫它 S 曲線。

cues.en: In other statistics literature, I've heard this referred to as a hill curve because it looks kind of like the up slope of a hill, but the formal term is a sigmoid.
cues.zh: 在其他統計文獻中，我聽過稱它為山丘曲線，因為看起來像山丘的上坡，不過正式名稱是 Sigmoid。

cues.en: You can see it goes from zero to one and it kind of climbs up slowly or smoothly, I should say, not necessarily slowly.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它從 0 到 1，慢慢爬升，或者應該說平滑地爬升，不一定慢。

cues.en: Now, this function is not necessarily bound between zero and one.
cues.zh: 這個函數不一定只能限制在 0 到 1。

cues.en: You can imagine multiplying this or having in the numerator a four instead of a one.
cues.zh: 可以想像把它乘上一個數，或把分子從 1 改成 4。

cues.en: And then if this were a four, then this function will actually go from zero up to four.
cues.zh: 如果這裡是 4，函數就會從 0 到 4。

cues.en: And then we could, for example, subtract two, and then we would have a sigmoid that goes from minus two up to plus two.
cues.zh: 接著，例如減去 2，就得到從 −2 到 +2 的 Sigmoid。

cues.en: So there's some ways to parameterize this to have this stretch beyond zero to one.
cues.zh: 所以有方法能透過參數調整，讓範圍超出 0 到 1。

cues.en: Now this beta parameter here turns out to be a key parameter.
cues.zh: 這裡 β 是關鍵參數。

cues.en: It's sometimes referred to as the heat parameter or the temperature parameter because it defines the steepness of this incline.
cues.zh: 有時叫熱參數或溫度參數，因為它決定上升的陡峭程度。

cues.en: So beta, this parameter beta here will tell us how steep this function climbs from zero up to one.
cues.zh: β 這個參數會告訴我們，函數從 0 升到 1 有多陡。

cues.en: So whether it's a really steep curve, like almost like a step function, or whether it's really gradual, basically like a linear function with just a little bit of bend to it.
cues.zh: 是非常陡，幾乎像階梯函數，還是非常平緩，基本上像稍微彎曲的線性函數。

cues.en: Alright, so that's the sigmoid function.
cues.zh: 以上是 Sigmoid 函數。

cues.en: Now, why am I telling you about the sigmoid when the title of this video is the logistic function?
cues.zh: 既然影片標題是邏輯斯函數，為什麼要介紹 Sigmoid？

cues.en: And anyway, what is the logistic function?
cues.zh: 而且，邏輯斯函數到底是什麼？

cues.en: Well, this is the logistic function. It's the natural log.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡的邏輯斯函數，是自然對數。

cues.en: In the previous video I talked about the natural log, and I spell it out L-O-G.
cues.zh: 上一部影片介紹自然對數，我把它寫成 log。

cues.en: But another way to refer to the natural log as opposed to a logarithm with some other base is ln.
cues.zh: 但要與其他底數的對數區分，自然對數也可以寫成 ln。

cues.en: So the natural log of, all of this business goes inside the natural log function.
cues.zh: 也就是對這整個內容取自然對數，全部放進自然對數函數裡。

cues.en: P divided by one minus P.
cues.zh: p 除以 1−p。

cues.en: So P here is a probability value.
cues.zh: 這裡 p 是機率值。

cues.en: So it varies between zero and one.
cues.zh: 所以介於 0 到 1。

cues.en: It cannot be negative and it cannot be greater than one.
cues.zh: 不能是負數，也不能大於 1。

cues.en: So the natural log rhythm of P divided by one minus p equals beta.
cues.zh: p 除以 1−p 的自然對數，等於 β。

cues.en: So this is called the logistic function.
cues.zh: 這叫做邏輯斯函數。

cues.en: It's really important in odds ratios when learning about probabilities and odds, it's also important for something called a soft max function,
cues.zh: 它對學習機率與勝算時的勝算比很重要，也對所謂 softmax 函數很重要，

cues.en: which is used in machine learning, and in artificial intelligence, in reinforcement learning, and in deep learning, you will learn more about
cues.zh: softmax 用在機器學習、人工智慧、強化學習與深度學習。你會更深入了解，

cues.en: where this formula comes from and how to work with it in the section on probability theory.
cues.zh: 這個公式的來源與運用方式，在機率理論那一節。

cues.en: So a bit later in this course.
cues.zh: 也就是本課程稍後的內容。

cues.en: What I want to do now is just focus on the math.
cues.zh: 現在，我只想專注在數學。

cues.en: So here's what you should do, pause the video and solve this equation for P.
cues.zh: 請先暫停影片，從這個方程式解出 p。

cues.en: Right now, this is solved for beta.
cues.zh: 目前是解成 β。

cues.en: We wanna solve for P.
cues.zh: 我們想解出 p。

cues.en: So do whatever you need to do to get this equation to be rewritten so that P is isolated, the probability value is isolated on one side
cues.zh: 所以用任何必要方法，重新改寫方程式，讓 p，也就是機率值，單獨留在，

cues.en: of the equation and everything else is on the other side of the equation.
cues.zh: 等號的一邊，其他所有項都在另一邊。

cues.en: Okay, and after you've finished, it's a little bit of a challenge, but you can use some of the knowledge that you learned in the past several videos.
cues.zh: 完成後，這有點挑戰，但能利用前幾部影片學過的知識。

cues.en: And when you've finished or when you've given up, I guess, then unpause video, come back and I'm going to work through this solution.
cues.zh: 完成後，或者放棄後，就恢復播放、回來看，我會一步步示範解法。

cues.en: Alright, so how did it go? Did you manage to solve for P?
cues.zh: 如何？成功解出 p 了嗎？

cues.en: Let us start by getting rid of this logarithm.
cues.zh: 先從消去這個對數開始。

cues.en: And remember from the last video, the way that you get rid of the logarithm is by taking E, using the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 記得上一部影片，消去對數的方法，是用 e，也就是自然指數。

cues.en: So we take E to the all of this business.
cues.zh: 把這一整個算式放到 e 的指數上。

cues.en: And of course, whatever you do to one side of the equation, you have to do to the other side of the equation as well.
cues.zh: 當然，對等號一邊做什麼，也必須對另一邊做相同的事。

cues.en: Now, when the expression gets pretty complicated and you wanna put the entire thing in the exponent, it's common to write exp for natural exponential.
cues.zh: 當算式很複雜，要把整個算式放在指數時，常會用 exp 表示自然指數。

cues.en: And then whatever's in parentheses is actually in the superscript.
cues.zh: 括號裡的內容，其實就是上標。

cues.en: It's actually in the power of E.
cues.zh: 也就是 e 的次方。

cues.en: Okay, so now we know that E and log cancel each other out.
cues.zh: 現在知道 e 與 log 會互相抵銷。

cues.en: So these two operations invert each other and we get P over one minus P equals E to the beta.
cues.zh: 這兩個運算互為反運算，得到 p/(1−p)=e^β。

cues.en: So we are not finished yet, right?
cues.zh: 還沒完成，對吧？

cues.en: Because we need to isolate one P on the left hand side of the equation.
cues.zh: 因為需要讓一個 p 單獨留在方程式左邊。

cues.en: So let's start by multiplying both sides of this equation by one minus P.
cues.zh: 先把方程式兩邊乘以 1−p。

cues.en: That gives us this, but we still have a problem because we need to get these two Ps together basically on one side.
cues.zh: 得到這個式子，但還有問題，因為基本上需要把這兩個 p 放到同一邊。

cues.en: Okay, so what I'm gonna do now is up here, expand out this multiplication, and then things are starting to get pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 現在，我要在上面展開乘法，事情開始變得有趣。

cues.en: Now what we can do is group together the two terms that contain the probability on one side of the equation and put the E on the other side of the equation.
cues.zh: 接著，把含有機率的兩項移到方程式同一邊，把 e 那項放到另一邊。

cues.en: So that's what I've done here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡做的事。

cues.en: So now we have the sum of two terms, both of which have P in them.
cues.zh: 現在有兩項相加，兩項都包含 p。

cues.en: So we can pull that P out, and then we get E to the beta equals one plus E to the beta times P.
cues.zh: 所以可以提出 p，得到 e^β=(1+e^β)×p。

cues.en: So now things are going well.
cues.zh: 現在進展順利。

cues.en: We have only one value of P one instance of this probability term over here.
cues.zh: 這裡的機率項 p，只剩下一次。

cues.en: So of course we divide by E to the beta, and I just swapped the sides here.
cues.zh: 接著當然就除以 e^β，我也把兩邊交換了。

cues.en: So on the one hand, this is fine, you could stop here.
cues.zh: 某種程度來說，這樣就可以了，可以在這裡停下。

cues.en: This is technically, you know the solution, but it's a little bit ugly to have E to the beta in the numerator and E to the beta in the denominator.
cues.zh: 技術上這就是答案，但分子、分母都有 e^β，有點不美觀。

cues.en: So what can we do here?
cues.zh: 可以怎麼做？

cues.en: Well, what we can do is multiply this expression by E to the minus beta divided by E to the minus beta.
cues.zh: 可以把這個式子，乘以 e^(−β)/e^(−β)。

cues.en: This is just a little trick that we're using here.
cues.zh: 這只是用到的一個小技巧。

cues.en: Now, this is equal to one, except, normally when you're doing something like this in math, you have to be careful that when you're introducing something into the denominator,
cues.zh: 這等於 1。不過通常在數學上做這種事，要小心：在分母引入某項時，

cues.en: you need to think about whether that can ever be zero.
cues.zh: 必須考慮它有沒有可能等於 0。

cues.en: And therefore whether you need to make some exceptions or some assumptions built in to your ultimate solution.
cues.zh: 從而判斷，是否需要在最終答案中加入例外或假設。

cues.en: However, remember from the last video, E to the anything can never be zero.
cues.zh: 但記得上一部影片，e 的任何次方都不會等於 0。

cues.en: This can never be zero.
cues.zh: 這永遠不會是 0。

cues.en: It can get really, really close to zero, but we don't have to worry about dividing by zero.
cues.zh: 它可以非常非常接近 0，但不需要擔心除以 0。

cues.en: Okay, and then we apply the law of exponents from several videos ago, and these bases are the same.
cues.zh: 接著套用前幾部影片的指數律，這些底數相同。

cues.en: So we can add the exponents here.
cues.zh: 所以能把指數相加。

cues.en: And so beta minus beta is zero.
cues.zh: β−β 是 0。

cues.en: So we get in the numerator E to the zero, which you'll remember is one.
cues.zh: 分子得到 e 的 0 次方，你應該記得，它等於 1。

cues.en: And here we get E to the minus beta over here.
cues.zh: 這裡則得到 e 的 −β 次方。

cues.en: So we're multiplying this entire denominator.
cues.zh: 我們要乘的是整個分母。

cues.en: So we get E to the minus beta, and here again we get E to the beta minus beta, which is E to the zero, which is one, and that gives us our final solution.
cues.zh: 所以得到 e^(−β)，這裡同樣得到 e^(β−β)，也就是 e^0=1，這就是最終解。

cues.en: That's the probability P.
cues.zh: 這就是機率 p。

cues.en: So that's how to solve the odds ratio here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡如何解出勝算比。

cues.en: This logistic function for P is P equals one over one plus E to the minus beta, which is really cool because that's exactly the sigmoid function
cues.zh: 把這個邏輯斯函數解成 p，得到 p=1/(1+e^(−β))。很有意思，因為這正是 Sigmoid 函數，

cues.en: that I showed in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 也就是上一張投影片展示的函數。

cues.en: Well, not exactly that one had an X there, but so this is just being evaluated for one particular value of X.
cues.zh: 也不完全一樣，那裡有 x，這裡是對某個特定 x 值求值。

cues.en: Alright, so in this video I introduced you to the logistic function and the sigmoid function, and you got some experience using a little bit of paper
cues.zh: 這部影片介紹了邏輯斯函數與 Sigmoid 函數，也讓你用一點紙，

cues.en: and pencil math to work through using natural exponent and natural logarithm to solve for probability values that turns out to be pretty important when we get
cues.zh: 和筆，練習利用自然指數與自然對數，解出機率值。到了，

cues.en: to the section on probabilities.
cues.zh: 機率那一節，這會相當重要。
